newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Finance in insurance ventures.
newsitem.headline: National Finance in insurance ventures.

text.p: Thailand's National Finance and Securities Plc said on Tuesday the company had invested 440 million baht ($15.7 million) to set up insurance and life assurance joint ventures.

The insurance venture, the National Insurance Co Ltd, has paid-up capital of 300 million baht, the other venture, National Life Assurance Co Ltd, has paid-up capital of 500 million baht, National Finance said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
National Finance holds a 55 percent stake in both companies, which were already awarded a license from the commerce ministry in April, it said.
